host.description: Context t (Trace) records lines: int/float/str/bool/thing. Context root is Thing id 0 and xs is IntList [0,1,2,3]. lmcode_return_* writes a separate invocation sink and adds no trace line. Host functions and methods follow their schema names and preserve the existing trace semantics. Rule entries are called by name after load; primitive args are JSON scalar values and object args are {type:Thing,id:N}, stored into parameter slots 0..n-1. Entry calls return one typed value or void.
host.entry_call: entries expect NAME ANNOTATION INTERFACE; every call runs the body once first, then selects the named entry. call expects line 2 ENTRY ARGS-JSON, args are stored in parameter slots 0..n-1, line 3 result int N|float X|string S|bool true|false|thing ID|void (an enum result is its constant name as string S; an object result is thing ID), then trace lines; call_error expects line 2 ENTRY ARGS-JSON, line 3 CODE, line 4 MESSAGE; call_error_at expects line 2 ENTRY ARGS-JSON, line 3 CODE, line 4 LINE, line 5 COLUMN, line 6 MESSAGE. Interface text is canonical `interface I(T1, ...) -> R` (parameter names are not on the wire). Loader rules per entry (LOAD_BAD_BYTECODE, message substrings pinned by the load-entry-* vectors): nparams equals the interface parameter count (`entry 'NAME' declares N parameter(s); interface I(...) -> R has M`), parameter local i has the interface's type i (`entry 'NAME' parameter I has type T; the interface expects U`), no parameter local is hidden (`entry 'NAME' parameter I is hidden`), and HALT depth is 0 for void or 1 otherwise (`entry 'NAME': HALT leaves N values`). call arity: RUN_HOST `call entry 'NAME' expects N argument(s); found M`. call needs no prior run(); it returns the single HALT value (none for void).
host.result_sink:
Optional trailing .expect line: sink JSON-OBJECT, mirrored as expect.sink in manifest. json is the exact serialized sink payload after execution, including partial writes on failure. frame is exact output: LMCODE_RETURN_BEGIN
 + json + 
LMCODE_RETURN_END
 only after body and selected entry succeed; empty on failure. Bind one sink for body plus entry, reset once before body, never between phases. Compare sink and frame on error paths as well as success; framing at body HALT before entry completion is forbidden.
host.expect: trace: the recorded lines in order, after a successful run. entries: one canonical entry line per rule in source order. call: line 2 selects an entry and JSON args, line 3 is the result, remaining lines are trace. call_error: calling with the wrong arity fails before execution. call_error_at: an entry runtime error carries exact code, line and column plus a message substring. runtime_error/runtime_error_at cover body execution. load_error: load() throws (nothing runs) and the message contains the substring.
